note: Per cell, from the result file's per-epoch history (or the slurm log for a running cell, marked partial): the epoch of minimum validation loss (raw and 5-epoch centered moving average), the loss at the end, the slope of the moving-average loss over the last 20 epochs, and the epoch of maximum moving-average validation Pearson beside the selected epoch. A minimum or maximum inside the last 20 epochs means the curve had not settled.
